description: An agent's RS-KYA level (L0 declared, L1 key-bound, L2 operator-verified), status, the verified facts behind it (key, operator contact, attestation, DNS domain, registration, bureau record) and what is missing for the next level. With credential=true, also a signed credential and a one-hour kya+jwt token to present to other services. Call with {"agent": "RS-XXXX-XXXX"}.

agent.description: Registration number (RS-XXXX-XXXX), handle or agent id

name: kya_lookup
title: Know Your Agent: look up an agent's RS-KYA level
